text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see Нарита Брайан's
announcement?
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
I did! That's why I decided to come
watch the
Hanshin Daishoten! After all...
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
"If she doesn't keep winning after this
race, her
announcement is meaningless."
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Her announcement at yesterday's award

ceremony was covered by the media and

broadcast around the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No matter who I'm up against or what
kind of race
I'm in, I'll tear the track to
shreds!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
